sql: select w.display_name,w.score,w.stage,w.reached_at,w.battle_index,r.id as run_id,r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.next_stage,r.battle_count,r.wins,r.losses,r.best_ovr,r.finished,r.proof_version,r.state from public.weekly_ovr_entries w join public.leaderboard_runs r on r.id=w.run_id where w.starts_at=(select max(starts_at) from public.weekly_ovr_periods) order by w.score desc,w.reached_at asc limit 2
